theorem lg_target (w : CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}.EssSurj) : UnivLE.{max u v, v} := by
  let F := CategoryTheory.uliftFunctor.{u, v}
  let h_full := F.Full
  let h_faithful := F.Faithful
  let h_ess_surj := w

  have h_preserves_colimits : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfSize.{max u v, max u v, u, max u v} F :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.instPreservesColimitsOfSizeUliftFunctor.{v, u}

  have h_preserves_limits : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimitsOfSize.{max u v, max u v, u, max u v} F :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.instPreservesLimitsOfSizeUliftFunctor.{v, u}

  have h_univle_max : UnivLE.{max u v, v} :=
    @CategoryTheory.AB5StarOfSize_of_univLE _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (ULift.{v, u} : Type u)
      (infer_instance : CategoryTheory.Category.{max u v, v} (ULift.{v, u} : Type u))
      h_preserves_colimits
      h_preserves_limits
      (infer_instance : UnivLE.{max u v, v})
      (infer_instance : UnivLE.{max u v, max u v})
      (infer_instance : CategoryTheory.AB5StarOfSize.{max u v, max u v, v, u} (ULift.{v, u} : Type u))

  exact h_univle_max
